class.name: InputComponent
class.brief_description: Binds input actions to callables for a possessed pawn.
class.description: Handed to [code]Pawn._setup_input_component[/code]. Bindings live as long as the possession does. Every query goes through the owning [PlayerController] [PlayerInput], so a pawn only ever sees its own player devices. Reading [Input] directly from a pawn script would move every pawn at once - that is the problem [PlayerInput] exists to solve. When the component has no owning controller, or that controller has no [LocalPlayer], it falls back to the global [Input] singleton, which is what this class did before per-player input existed.

method.name: bind_action
method.description: Calls [param action] whenever [param action_name] reaches [param trigger_event]. Bind from [method Pawn._setup_input_component], which runs [b]on possession[/b] - binding from [code]_ready[/code] is too early and will not fire.

method.name: get_action_strength
method.description: The action's analogue value for the owning player, between 0 and 1.

method.name: get_axis
method.description: The difference between two actions' strengths, as [method Input.get_axis] would give it - but scoped to the owning player.

method.name: get_owning_controller
method.description: The controller this component was registered with. Null while unregistered, in which case every query falls back to the global [Input] singleton - the pre-local-multiplayer behaviour.

method.name: get_player_input
method.description: Null when unregistered or when the owning controller has no [LocalPlayer].

method.name: get_vector
method.description: The per-player counterpart of [method Input.get_vector]. This is how a pawn reads its own stick.

method.name: is_action_just_pressed
method.description: Whether the owning player pressed [param action_name] this frame.

method.name: is_action_just_released
method.description: Whether the owning player released [param action_name] this frame.

method.name: is_action_pressed
method.description: Whether the owning player is holding [param action_name]. Use this rather than [method Input.is_action_pressed], which merges every device and would move both pawns in a two-player game.

method.name: remove_all_bindings
method.description: Drops every binding on this component.

method.name: remove_binding
method.description: Removes one binding. All three arguments have to match what [method bind_action] was given.

method.name: set_owning_controller
method.description: Sets which controller this component listens through. [PlayerController] does this on possession; a project does not.

members.member: While false the component fires no bindings and every query reads as unpressed. This is the gate for input that should stop during a pause or while a [LineEdit] has focus - the [InputRouter] itself never stops routing.

constants.constant: Fired every frame while the action is held.
Fired once when the action is pressed.
Fired once when the action is released.
